'''Vodel''' is a manufacturer in ''Elite Dangerous''. Frontier Developments has described Vodel as a Core Dynamics subsidiary and the developer of the [[Rhino]], an upcoming large [[Surface Recon Vehicles|Surface Recon Vehicle]] built for [[Surface Mining|surface mining]].<ref name="frontier-august-dev-log">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments, 27 August 2026.</ref>
